meta.title: WhimCut — Cut what catches your eye
meta.description: A visual tool for cutting, collecting and creating on Mac.

hero.title:
CUT WHAT
CATCHES
YOUR EYE.
hero.body:
For the things that make you pause.
A color, a shape, a little detail, a fleeting idea —
keep what catches your eye, and make it yours.
hero.instruction: Draw any shape to cut it out

cut.title: CUT
cut.body:
Select anything.
Any shape, any size,
from any app or website.

collect.title: COLLECT
collect.body:
All your clips are saved
in one place. Search, revisit
and organize anytime.

create.title: CREATE
create.body:
Drag and drop your
fragments into a MoodBoard.
Mix, match, make it yours.
create.note: Made something you love? Save it to your Idea Gallery.

pricing.label: PRICING
pricing.headline:
FREE TO START.
UPGRADE WHEN YOU
NEED MORE.
pricing.subtext:
Download WhimCut and use all three modules for free — forever.
Unlock higher limits with a one-time purchase when your library grows.

free.desc:
Download and start using all three modules today.
No time limit.
features: Up to 70 Cutouts in Idea Gallery
Up to 30 Collages in Idea Gallery

full.desc:
No limits on cutouts, collages, or layers.
No subscription, ever.
